relationships.subject: migraine comorbid with IC/BPS
relationships.evidence_quote: higher serum levels of IL-1β, IL-6, PGE2, and SP

relationships.subject: IL-1β
relationships.evidence_quote: IL-1β在其中发挥重要的调节作用，既可作用于胶质细胞，释放炎症因子，也可以调控SP、PGE2等因子的表达，促进炎症发生

key_findings: 28.7% of 303 IC/BPS patients had comorbid migraine and showed more severe symptoms and higher serum IL-1β, IL-6, PGE2 and SP.
IC/BPS severity (ICSI) positively correlated with headache intensity, frequency and duration.
